about.title: About Us
about.intro1: FastApp is an enterprise-level full-stack application framework dedicated to providing complete application development solutions for enterprises.
about.intro2: We provide comprehensive technical support from client apps to web, from admin systems to corporate websites, from frontend to backend.
about.missionDesc: Through advanced technology stack and best practices, help enterprises quickly build high-quality applications, reduce development costs, and improve development efficiency.
about.techAdvantage1: High-performance backend services based on Swoole coroutines

products.title: Products & Services
products.mobileDesc: Client app built with Tauri (https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri): system WebView for UI, Rust for native capabilities and packaging.
products.adminDesc: Enterprise-level admin system frontend application built with Vue3 + TypeScript + Element Plus.
products.websiteDesc: Corporate website built with Nuxt.js 4.2, supporting SSR/SSG, SEO optimization, internationalization and other features.
products.backendDesc: High-performance backend service built with Hyperf 3.1 + Swoole, providing API interfaces, WebSocket services and other functions.
products.permissionDesc: Complete RBAC permission system to ensure application security and data access control.
products.pluginDesc: Flexible plugin extension mechanism to meet different business scenario needs.
